title: The Supernatural Eye — LIMO AI Studio
music: Dramatic orchestral sting with low drums for shots 1–3 (family-drama tension); bright modern pulse from shot 4 (product reveal). Own or licensed track only; ducks automatically under speech.

scenes.description: Luxurious family mansion. The ADAM father stands angrily before his biological son and points at the adopted son standing proudly at his side. The biological son flinches in shock. [CASTING APPROVED 2026-10-19: father adam_man, biological son adam_boy, adopted son limo_boy] [VARIANT PROPOSED: adam_man formal suit + angry expression (adam_man.formal_angry.v1), pending owner review — until approved the canonical "determined" expression is used]
scenes.environment: Opulent mansion hall, marble floor, gold chandelier, tall dark curtains; dramatic low-key lighting, warm key light from the chandelier, cool rim light from the windows; evening.

actions.adam_man: points sharply at the biological son, leaning forward, angry gesture with the other hand toward the adopted son
actions.adam_boy: steps back in shock, eyes wide, hands half raised
actions.limo_boy: stands beside the father, chin up, arms crossed, smug half-smile

scenes.camera: Medium-wide low angle on the father, slow push-in toward the biological son's face.

dialogue.speaker: adam_man
dialogue.text: هذاك ربّيناه، بصح نتا ما تسوا والو!

scenes.sound: Room tone of a large hall, a single dramatic string hit when the father points.

continuity.lighting: dramatic low-key: warm chandelier key, cool window rim
continuity.notes: Establishes the family; father wears his gold watch on the left wrist (needed in shot 2).

scenes.description: The biological son's eye glows gold (supernatural effect only; his canonical iris colour returns afterwards). He stares at the father's supposedly luxurious watch in the foreground. A supernatural price overlay reveals the real price. The price overlay is a render text layer, never part of the generated pixels.
scenes.environment: Same mansion hall and lighting as shot 1 (continuous moment).

actions.adam_boy: his eye lights up gold, he leans toward the watch on the father's wrist in the foreground, then whispers

scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder from the son to the father's wrist and watch in the foreground (father's face out of frame), rack focus from the glowing eye to the watch.
scenes.sound: Magical shimmer when the eye glows; soft digital 'scan' tick when the price appears.

continuity.lighting: dramatic low-key: warm chandelier key, cool window rim
continuity.notes: Same moment as shot 1; the gold eye glow is an effect only.

scenes.description: Close-up of the biological son. He turns to look straight into the camera with a knowing, determined look. Dramatic impact, freeze frame, transition to the LIMO reveal.
scenes.environment: Same mansion, background softly blurred; the gold glow fades from his eye.

actions.adam_boy: turns his head to the camera, raises one eyebrow, slight confident smile, freezes on the last syllable

scenes.camera: Close-up, slow push-in, ends on a freeze frame.
scenes.sound: Deep dramatic impact boom on the freeze frame, then a whoosh transition.

continuity.lighting: dramatic low-key: warm chandelier key, cool window rim
continuity.notes: Ends on a freeze frame that becomes the first frame of the shot 4 transition.

scenes.description: Reveal LIMO AI Studio: the freeze frame shrinks into the Animation Studio storyboard on a phone screen, then the genuine LIMO logo and wordmark appear. [MEDIA: real LIMO screen capture + approved logo, no AI-generated UI]
scenes.environment: Clean lavender/white LIMO brand background (approved design colours).
scenes.camera: Pull back from the freeze frame into the phone screen, gentle tilt.
scenes.narration: عجبتك القصة؟ تقدر تصنع كيفها بـLIMO AI!
scenes.sound: Bright modern music starts; soft UI click.

continuity.lighting: clean soft studio light, lavender/white brand palette
continuity.notes: Product part: real LIMO screen captures and the approved logo — not AI-generated.

continuity.lighting: clean soft studio light, lavender/white brand palette
